3 A student investigates the effect of dissolving salt on the boiling point temperature of water.

parts.label: (a)
parts.text:
Procedure
The student:
step 1 half fills a boiling tube (large test-tube) with distilled water
step 2 heats the water until it boils
step 3 records the boiling point temperature in Table 3.1
step 4 adds one spatula of salt to the water in the boiling tube
step 5 heats the salt solution until it boils and records the boiling point temperature in
Table 3.1.
The student repeats steps 4 and 5 until seven spatulas of salt have been added.

4 A student investigates boiling and purity.
Methanol and water are both liquids and they have been mixed together.
The boiling point of methanol is 65 °C and the boiling point of water is 100 °C.
The methanol can be separated from the water by distillation.
